product_metadata.title: Rachael Ray Cucina Nonstick Frying Pan Set / Fry Pan Set / Skillet Set - 9.25 Inch and 11 Inch, Blue
features: Durable frying pans with even heat distribution: These fry pans feature durable aluminum construction that heats quickly and evenly
Long lasting nonstick: Fry pans have long-lasting nonstick interiors for easy food release and cleanup
Dual-riveted, grip handles: The skillets' comfortable grippy handles are double-riveted for extra strength
Oven safe: Oven safe to 400°F, this nonstick frying pan set is a great complement to many other items in the Rachael Ray collections
description: Because one fun and functional frying pan is never enough, enjoy the Rachael Ray Cucina Porcelain Enamel Nonstick Frying Pan Set, a two-piece combo that will bring style and purpose to any kitchen.Use the smaller 9.25-inch nonstick fry pan to recreate Rachael's Grilled Brie and Fig Sandwiches or grab the large 11-inch frying pan to pull together cheddar and bacon omelettes. Combining superior performance, fun contemporary colors and durable materials, this nonstick frying pan set can handle everyone’s favorite dishes. Sturdy construction promotes even heating, helping to reduce hot spots that can burn foods, and the bold hues of the Frying Pans' enamel exteriors show plenty of stylish kitchen personality. Durable nonstick interiors provide superior food release and make cleanup a breeze. Comfortable grippy handles are double riveted for extra strength and oven safe to 400°F, and this Frying Pan Set makes a great gift and complements many other items in Rachael's collections.Serve up a generous helping of convenience and style with the bold and contemporary Rachael Ray Cucina Porcelain Enamel Nonstick Frying Pan Set.
